{{Quote|Echo Station 3-T-8. We have spotted Imperial walkers.|Trey Callum|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Echo Station 3-T-8''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] post outside [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Maren Kelsome]] reported the first sighting of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] to the station just prior to the onset of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Station [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Trey Callum/Legends|Trey Callum]] then relayed the message to the rest of Echo Base.<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="SWBoard">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1545#16926420|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2007-09-26|time=5:34 PM}}</ref> The post, which was garrisoned by troopers and and a pair of [[Laser cannon/Legends|turrets]], was eliminated by the advance Imperial forces.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/walkersighting.gif "Walker Sighting" card] from the [[1996]] [[Hoth Limited]] expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] includes Trey Callum's quote from the film warning Echo Base of the AT-ATs' presence. However, the card mistakenly refers to Echo Station 3-T-8 as "'''Echo station 3TA'''."
